verdict: Astera Labs' revenue leapt 154% to a record $584.9M as its Scorpio fabric switches for AI data centers hit volume production — and it kept $182.9M of that as profit.

kpis.label: Revenue
kpis.note: +154% vs a year ago; +49% vs Q2 2026

kpis.label: Gross margin
kpis.note: $422.8M of gross profit on $584.9M of sales

kpis.label: Cash & investments
kpis.note: Cash plus marketable securities at Sep 30, 2026

segments.name: Singapore
segments.note: Sales billed to customers in Singapore — mostly the manufacturing partners that build AI servers and racks for the big cloud companies. This is the billing address, not where the chips end up being used.

segments.name: China
segments.note: Sales billed to customers in China, again largely manufacturing partners building AI hardware.

segments.name: Taiwan
segments.note: Sales billed to customers in Taiwan, a hub for electronics manufacturing.

segments.name: Other countries
segments.note: Sales billed everywhere else, up more than fourfold from a small base.

segments.name: United States
segments.note: Sales billed directly in the US. The small share is about billing routes through overseas factories, not weak US demand — most end customers are US cloud companies.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Designing the next chips — Scorpio fabric switches, Aries signal conditioners and Leo memory controllers — and paying the engineers who build them.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling to cloud companies and server makers, and supporting design wins.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company — finance, legal and admin.

otherDetail: Interest and other income was $13.0M — mostly interest earned on the company's $1.4B pile of cash and marketable securities.
oneTimers: Operating costs include $81.7M of stock-based compensation in the quarter (pay in shares rather than cash). Leaving that and similar items out, the company's own non-GAAP operating income was $261.6M and non-GAAP EPS was $1.32, versus $179.1M and $0.99 on a GAAP basis.

takeaways.title: Scorpio took off
takeaways.text: Revenue hit a record $584.9M, up 154% from a year ago and 49% from Q2. The Scorpio fabric switches — chips that link racks of AI accelerators together — ramped to high-volume production and became the company's largest product family.

takeaways.title: Very profitable growth
takeaways.text: Gross margin was 72.3% and operating income was $179.1M, a 31% operating margin. Net income was $182.9M, helped by $13.0M of interest income, against a small $9.1M tax bill.

takeaways.title: One customer is half the business
takeaways.text: A single customer accounted for 53% of revenue in the quarter (by billing address — the chips flow through manufacturing partners to cloud end-customers, so this can swing between quarters). Management guided Q4 revenue to $730M–$750M, which would be another jump of about 25%.
